en: Adopt the unmodified official PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 in place of the custom non-commercial license, with copyright attribution in NOTICE. Commercial uses outside the license require separate written authorization.
Align all nine README languages and package metadata with the standardized license. Third-party licenses and the terms attached to previously distributed copies remain unchanged.
zh: 采用未经修改的官方 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0，替换自定义非商业许可证，并在 NOTICE 中保留版权声明。许可证允许范围之外的商业用途须另行取得书面授权。
九种语言的 README 与软件包元数据同步更新。第三方许可证及此前已分发副本所附的许可条款不变。
